name: Verna's Westfall Stew Recipe
summary: Verna's Westfall Stew Recipe travels to Salma Saldean as the Furlbrows prepare to leave their farm. Her handwritten formula carries a familiar comfort for those who remain.

sections.title: A Farewell Gift
sections.body: Verna and Farmer Furlbrow have homesteaded in Westfall for years, but the Defias Brotherhood and rogue harvest golems now run rampant across the countryside. They wait for their wagon to be repaired so they can escape toward Stormwind. While they wait, Verna writes down her beloved formula for Westfall Stew. She entrusts the recipe to travelers bound for her neighboring friend, Salma Saldean, so the familiar comfort of the stew can endure for those left behind.

faq.q: Why is Verna giving away her stew recipe?
faq.answer: Verna and her husband are fleeing Westfall because bandits and rogue machines have overrun their fields. As they leave their homestead, Verna wants her friend Salma Saldean to keep making the stew for those who remain.

faq.q: Who is the recipe meant for?
aliases: who do i bring the recipe to
where does the stew recipe go
faq.answer: The recipe is meant for Salma Saldean, who lives just beyond the fork in the road at the Saldean Farm.

faq.q: Where are the Furlbrows planning to go?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows wait for their wagon to be repaired so they can flee to the safety of Stormwind City, escaping the chaos and brigandry threatening the countryside.

faq.q: What makes Westfall Stew notable in the region?
faq.answer: Westfall Stew is a regional staple made possible by local farming and game. When food is scarce and farms are abandoned, sharing hearty recipes helps surviving farming families endure.

angles.text: For cooks, this handwritten paper is treasured local lore, preserving Westfall's culinary heritage as its farms collapse.
For the Alliance, the recipe speaks to loyal homesteaders driven from their land by lawlessness while Stormwind struggles to project its authority.
